title: Syrian Court Sentences Assad to Death In Absentia for Crimes Against Humanity
detail: A Syrian court under the post-Assad transitional government sentenced former President Bashar al-Assad to death in absentia for crimes against humanity, marking a landmark accountability ruling. Assad, who fled to Russia following the regime's collapse in December 2024, was tried for his role in the systematic murder, torture, and forced disappearance of civilians throughout the Syrian civil war. The ruling is largely symbolic given Assad's exile, but carries significant weight as the first formal judicial accountability measure by the new Syrian state against its former leader.

media.caption: Syrian court sentences Bashar al-Assad to death in absentia for crimes against humanity
